article_title: Why the King's Caribbean tour could be 'biggest risk of his reign'

tasks.prompt: Why does the article describe King Charles's Caribbean tour as a major risk?
options: It places him amid unresolved debates over slavery, reparations, apology and the monarchy's future in the region.
It is his first journey outside Europe as King.
The three host governments have cancelled all official meetings.
Buckingham Palace has refused to plan for demonstrations.
tasks.correct_answer: It places him amid unresolved debates over slavery, reparations, apology and the monarchy's future in the region.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הסיור מציב את המלך בלב הדיון הטעון על העבדות, פיצויים, התנצלות והמשך מעמד המלוכה באזור.

tasks.prompt: Which three countries are on the King's nine-day itinerary?
options: Jamaica, Barbados and Belize
The Bahamas, Guyana, and Antigua and Barbuda
Guyana, Trinidad and Tobago, and Grenada
The Bahamas, Canada, and Antigua and Barbuda
tasks.correct_answer: The Bahamas, Guyana, and Antigua and Barbuda
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המסלול בן תשעת הימים כולל את איי בהאמה, גיאנה ולבסוף אנטיגואה וברבודה.

tasks.prompt: What position will the King follow on an official apology for Britain's role in the slave trade?
options: He will apologise in every speech.
He will let each host country write the apology.
He will follow government advice and not issue an official apology.
He will postpone all discussion until after Chogm.
tasks.correct_answer: He will follow government advice and not issue an official apology.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המלך יפעל לפי עצת הממשלה ולא ימסור התנצלות רשמית, אף שהוא צפוי להכיר בעוולות העבר.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “optics” refer to in the criticism of the 2022 royal tour?
options: The quality of cameras used by the press
The eyesight of people attending events
Scientific equipment presented during the visit
How actions and images appeared to the public
tasks.correct_answer: How actions and images appeared to the public
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר זה optics פירושו האופן שבו מעשים ותמונות נראים ומתפרשים בעיני הציבור.

tasks.prompt: Why are planners especially mindful of William and Catherine's 2022 Caribbean tour?
options: Its awkward images, outdated-looking events and protests offer examples of mistakes to avoid.
It proved that Caribbean countries reject all royal visits.
It included exactly the same three countries and speeches.
It ended with Britain agreeing to pay reparations.
tasks.correct_answer: Its awkward images, outdated-looking events and protests offer examples of mistakes to avoid.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הסיור ב־2022 ספג ביקורת על תמונות צורמות, אירועים מיושנים ומחאות, ולכן הוא משמש לקח תכנוני לסיור הנוכחי.

tasks.prompt: What makes the physical schedule demanding for the King?
options: He must travel alone without royal staff.
Every engagement takes place outdoors.
He will cross the Atlantic, visit three countries and attend about 36 engagements near age 78 while receiving cancer treatment.
He is required to walk between all three countries.
tasks.correct_answer: He will cross the Atlantic, visit three countries and attend about 36 engagements near age 78 while receiving cancer treatment.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המסע כולל טיסה טרנס־אטלנטית, שלוש מדינות וכ־36 אירועים, כשהמלך קרוב לגיל 78 ועדיין מקבל טיפול בסרטן.

tasks.prompt: Identify two signs in the article that the region's relationship with the monarchy is changing.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להביא שתי דוגמאות קונקרטיות לשינוי פוליטי או ציבורי במעמד המלוכה באזור.
expected_points: Leaders of all three countries support reparatory justice.
Republicanism has significant support in Antigua and Barbuda and the Bahamas.
Elected officials in Antigua and Barbuda no longer have to pledge allegiance to the King.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the tour's main risks and its possible diplomatic rewards.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להציג את הוויכוחים ההיסטוריים והפוליטיים, סכנת המחאות והטעויות התדמיתיות, לצד ההזדמנות לחזק קשרים ושיתוף פעולה.
expected_points: Debates over slavery, reparations, apology and republicanism could produce protests and challenge the monarchy's moral standing.
Memories of missteps on the 2022 tour increase scrutiny of presentation and symbolism.
The hosts also value ties involving rainforests, culture, trade, energy and agriculture.
A sensitive and empathetic visit could strengthen relationships and the Commonwealth.

tasks.prompt: Analyse the tension between the King's personal acknowledgement of slavery and the government's control over apology and reparations.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את ההבדל בין הכרה מוסרית של המלך לבין סמכות הממשלה למדיניות, ולהראות כיצד הפער מגביל את תגובתו בסיור.
expected_points: The King has called the slave trade an appalling atrocity and an indelible stain.
He is expected to acknowledge historical wrongs during the programme.
Official apologies and reparations are treated as government decisions.
The government will not apologise or pay reparations, limiting how far the King can go despite public pressure.

tasks.prompt: Write a short editorial assessing whether the tour is more likely to strengthen or weaken the monarchy's Caribbean relationships. Use at least three article details and address the opposing view.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג טענה ברורה, להשתמש בשלושה פרטים לפחות, ולשקול גם את הסיכוי להצלחה וגם את הסיכונים ההיסטוריים, הפוליטיים והתדמיתיים.
expected_points: States a clear judgement about the likely effect of the tour.
Uses evidence about reparations, republicanism, protests or the lack of an official apology.
Uses evidence about diplomatic, environmental, cultural or economic ties.
Addresses the King's capacity for empathy or the risk of repeating 2022-style missteps.
